alignment.inherited: Standard60/24 factors, mixed/reverse grouping, decimal-minute contrast and ferry context.
alignment.corrected: Audit real-time claim replaced by explicit accelerated clock semantics; displayed answer drives checking, no unsupported unit/case fallback.
alignment.extended: Same-duration nonnormalized feedback, bounded reversible unit notation model, separate optional digital-clock bridge.

currentSource.scope: Current Lite source bytes; sourceFiles/sourceHashes outside currentSource remain historical supplied-snapshot provenance.
currentSource.reviewBoundary: Source binding only. Current content/alignment decisions and technical evidence are separate; teacher and learner validation remain pending.

canonicalPrerequisiteGroups.rationale: Aikayksiköiden suhteiden merkitys on ydin; operaatio määräytyy tehtävästä.

planning.assumed: Qualitative/standard-second duration required. Operation support depends on conversion direction; grouping/addition model supplies bridge without a new global hardgate.
coTaught: Digital time notation introduced only in optional transfer (Lite assumesM-TIME-02); no frozen edge added.
planning.scope: Seconds/minutes/hours/day-unit, normalized mixed durations; optional same-day ferry clock bridge. No calendar/DST model or general decimal assessment.
planning.evidenceLimits: Checked typed representation of given situations; no formal independent/retained mastery, physical timing proficiency or personal history.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Inherited OPH registry references; foreign sources contextual, exact lesson/story/ranges/playback are project decisions.
planning.assetProvenance: Original SVG/clock/unit renderer; supplied Aava map PNG unchanged. Existing public licence/release holds retained.

extensions.timingSemantics: Grouping animation transforms notation, not elapsed time. Separate optionalclock:10modelmin/1playbacks, step5modelmin; stops30min, pauseboth/noautoplayresume.
extensions.informationalMetadata: Executable truth lives in the source-owned module and exact revision; classification/range record describes that implementation, not a dynamic external model declaration.
